title: 两杯热饮 master(道具锚)
prompt: Macro product photograph looking down into a car center console. Subject fills the frame: two identical tall paper takeaway coffee cups with white plastic lids, standing upright side by side, each seated in one of the two round cup holders of a beige-interior car console. The two cups are the clear focus and dominate the frame; one cup clearly full and untouched. Overcast blue-cyan cold daylight, slightly high contrast, clean, near-static locked macro camera. Only the console surface and the cup holders are visible, softly blurred behind the cups; no windshield, no sky, no dashboard, no steering wheel, no seats, no people, no faces — a tight still-life insert, not a wide cabin shot and not a portrait. Clean frame — no text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no pinyin anywhere in the image.
note: 两杯热饮道具锚;她那杯始终满没动。
